summary.name: Shadowsocks
summary.one_liner: Shadowsocks is a fast tunnel proxy project designed to help users bypass firewalls, with its project site and source on GitHub.
use_cases: route traffic through an encrypted proxy
secure internet traffic on mobile devices
run a proxy on OpenWRT routers
use a socks5 proxy on macOS
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Shadowsocks as a fast tunnel proxy that helps bypass firewalls. It states the tool uses asynchronous I/O and event-driven programming for speed. It says it supports industry-level encryption algorithms and allows custom algorithms. It is optimized for mobile devices and wireless networks with low CPU and bandwidth usage. The page says it is available on Windows, Linux, Mac, Android, iOS, and OpenWRT.
notable: Asynchronous I/O and event-driven design for speed
Pluggable encryption with support for custom algorithms
Low CPU and bandwidth usage for mobile and wireless networks
Listed as a socks5 proxy app (ShadowsocksX) for macOS in awesome-mac
caveats: Page does not state a license for the software itself beyond the website being MIT licensed
Page gives no specific setup steps or version details
